title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.

Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Gerente de Inteligência Artificial
description:
Nossa Oportunidade:

Você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, inovação e quer fazer parte de um ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo e em constante evolução? Então essa oportunidade é para você!

Na Capgemini, valorizamos o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Por isso, oferecemos modelos de trabalho flexível, híbrido, de acordo com as necessidades do projeto. Nosso objetivo é proporcionar a melhor experiência para você, respeitando seu estilo de vida e promovendo bem-estar.

  • Montar e gerenciar um time multidisciplinar (engenheiros de IA, arquitetos, analistas de negócio, designers).
  • Promover cultura de inovação, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo.

  • Atuar como ponto focal para líderes internos, clientes e parceiros estratégicos.
  • Garantir alinhamento com áreas de negócio, tecnologia e operações.

Inovação e Aceleração

  • Implementar frameworks ágeis e práticas de design thinking para ideação e prototipagem.
  • Integrar tecnologias emergentes (GenAI, RAG, automação, cloud) em soluções escaláveis.

  • Controlar budget do laboratório e buscar oportunidades de funding interno e externo.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de iniciativas de inovação e transformação digital.
  • Conhecimento sólido em Inteligência Artificial, cloud e tecnologias emergentes.
  • Habilidade de gestão de equipes multidisciplinares e relacionamento com stakeholders.
  • Forte visão estratégica e capacidade de execução.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para conversação.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento:

Na Capgemini, você pode ser quem você é. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo por meio de comitês como:

  • – Empoderamento feminino e equidade de gênero.
  • Capgemini Black – Representatividade e valorização da cultura negra.
  • LGBTQIA+@Capgemini, Capgemini Accessibility, entre outros.

Nossas vagas são para todas as pessoas, independentemente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência.

A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. title: Cortex Cloud Sales Specialist - FSI
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. Job Description

Your Career:

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sales Specialist to drive the growth of our Cortex and Cloud business to cover strategic and major accounts in the private sector, mainly in Sao Paolo.

The ideal candidate will operate in a high-growth environment at scale, thrive in driving innovation, have a solid background in cybersecurity sales, and a deep understanding of security solutions. They will have a proven track record of developing strong customer relationships and executing strategies that support rapid expansion and success. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in collaboration with internal teams, engages effectively with customers, and drives revenue growth through the sale of complex solutions.

Your Impact:

  • Join the fastest growing team where experience meets cutting-edge solutions

  • Build and cultivate strong customer relationships, driving business growth within the region.

  • Partner with the core sales team to align customer strategies and engagements with Cortex and Cloud business objectives.

  • Take full ownership of leading strategic sales campaigns, sales forecasting, utilizing in-depth knowledge of sales cycles from initial contact through procurement.

  • Engage in deep technical discussions beyond standard sales presentations and pitches; while translating complex technical cybersecurity solutions into clear business value propositions for customers.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including sales engineers, to provide tailored customer-centric solutions.

  • Partner with Alliances to develop joint strategies, enhance customer engagement and deliver innovative solutions for existing and prospective clients.

  • Travel domestically as needed to meet with customers and attend key business events.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 5+ years of field sales experience focusing on key customer accounts and delivering value to Enterprise or Major-level accounts.

  • Extensive platform selling experience in complex sales with multiple buying centers.

  • Experience selling Cybersecurity, SIEM, EDR or CNAPP (DevSecOps, CloudOps) solutions is highly preferred.

  • Established trusted relationships with CIOs and CISOs with the ability to influence and drive strategic conversations

  • Expertise in applying complex solution sales methodologies to drive results.

  • Experience working with channel partners and a deep understanding of a channel-centric go-to-market strategy.

  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment while collaborating effectively with sales engineers and cross-functional teams.

  • Experience operating in a continuous adoption, expansion, and upsell sales motion within a matrixed sales organization is preferred

  • Willingness to travel domestically as necessary to meet business needs.

Additional Information

The Team

Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won't find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn't committed to your success with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You are an amazing salesperson - you are just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.

Aqui, performance tem propósito, estrutura tem calor humano e ambição anda junto com ética.

Nosso produto é uma rede social líder em monetização de conteúdo no Brasil, em plena expansão internacional. Esse crescimento exige um(a) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) com mentalidade de engenharia, foco em automação, observabilidade e resiliência — capaz de operar e evoluir ambientes críticos, distribuídos e de larga escala.

Responsabilidades

Administração, Observabilidade e Operação

  • Projetar e operar ambientes altamente disponíveis, escaláveis e resilientes em AWS e Azure .
  • Construir e manter SLOs, SLIs e SLAs , garantindo confiabilidade alinhada ao negócio.
  • Implementar práticas completas de observabilidade (métricas, logs, tracing, dashboards, alertas).
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e corrigir incidentes em tempo real.
  • Participar ativamente de on-call , garantindo resposta rápida e eficaz a incidentes críticos.

Automação, Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Criar automações de provisioning, deploy, monitoramento e testes (Python, Go, Bash ou Node.js).
  • Desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD com rollback seguro e validações robustas.
  • Operar e gerenciar containers em Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS e AKS .
  • Implementar infraestrutura como código com Terraform , CloudFormation ou Pulumi.

Arquitetura, Resiliência e Segurança

  • Realizar tuning básico em bancos SQL e NoSQL, garantindo confiabilidade e desempenho.
  • Configurar redes: DNS, rotas, firewalls, VPC, load balancing e componentes essenciais.
  • Aplicar políticas de segurança (IAM, RBAC, hardening e conformidade).
  • Conduzir testes de caos, cenários de falha, DR e resiliência.
  • Criar ferramentas internas que aumentem eficiência e reduzam débito operacional.

O que valorizamos

Mentalidade de engenharia e automação: eliminação de tarefas manuais e criação de soluções escaláveis.

Capacidade analítica e orientação a dados: decisões guiadas por evidências.

Colaboração multidisciplinar: integração com Engenharia, Segurança, Arquitetura e Produto.

Clareza na comunicação: essencial em ambientes críticos.

Autonomia, resiliência e priorização: atuação madura em cenários de pressão e alta complexidade.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida operando ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade.
  • Domínio em AWS e Azure .
  • Experiência com Infra as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi).
  • Containers e orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS, AKS .
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
  • Observabilidade: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace .
  • Conhecimento em redes (DNS, TCP/IP, VPC, firewalls, protocolos).
  • Noções sólidas de bancos relacionais e NoSQL.
  • Scripts e automações (Python, Go, Bash ou Node.js).
  • Vivência com incidentes, RCA estruturado e práticas modernas de SRE.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica (fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce, telecom).
  • Conhecimento em Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS ou SNS.
  • Práticas avançadas de Zero Trust e segurança em nuvem.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas distribuídas e event-driven.
  • Certificações relevantes (AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes, Azure).
  • Participação em programas estruturados de on-call.
  • Contribuição para a comunidade (open source, artigos, palestras).

Modelo de contratação e ambiente

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Local: Presencial — Zona Sul de São Paulo/SP
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com cultura forte, liberdade técnica e foco em inovação.
  • Estrutura horizontal, com autonomia para propor, testar e evoluir soluções.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico (para CNPJs ativos há pelo menos 6 meses) ;
  • Cartão Caju;
  • TotalPass;
  • Estacionamento conveniado;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível técnico, aprendizado contínuo e impacto direto no negócio.

Por que entrar na Privacy

Estamos evoluindo e ampliando nossa infraestrutura para suportar o crescimento acelerado da plataforma.

Como SRE, você terá impacto direto na confiabilidade, segurança, escala e eficiência dos sistemas que atendem milhões de usuários.

Se você busca um ambiente técnico desafiador, com autonomia e cultura de engenharia madura, essa é a oportunidade ideal.

title: Sr. Full-Stack Engineer (Java/React)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD

We are seeking  a highly-skilled Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join these high-impact teams. You will collaborate closely with design, product, and engineering experts to deliver innovative, real-time solutions that elevate our partners' retail offerings.

What You’ll Do:

You will be expected to operate as a full-stack owner, driving development from the database to the user interface, with a strong commitment to quality and collaboration.

  • Lead the development of high-quality, robust, observable, and measurable applications using a user-centric approach and  disciplined eXtreme Programming (XP) practices .
  • Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD) and  Pair Programming as core, daily engineering functions to ensure code quality and shared ownership.
  • Contribute across the stack, developing business logic with  Java/Spring Boot on the backend and building intuitive user interfaces with  React on the frontend.
  • Design and implement scalable, event-driven solutions utilizing  Kafka .
  • Participate in the entire Agile application lifecycle in collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  • Leverage critical thinking, experimentation, data, and industry best practices to implement desired business outcomes.
  • Facilitate team ceremonies and actively give and receive feedback that is empathetic, actionable, and specific.
  • Practice emergent architecture with sane defaults and build software that is easy to use and easy to modify.
  • Lead technical initiatives not only on the team but also across the department.

Team Focus Areas:

Engineers will be assigned to collaborate on the following mission-critical teams focused on modernizing core retail functions. You will be instrumental in the following key initiatives:

Merchandising Systems Modernization
  • Merchandise Assortment Planning (MAP): Build and extend platform interfaces to capture data in software (not spreadsheets), enabling better downstream decision-making.
  • Merchandising Financial Planning: Focus on improving data consistency and quality across major merchandising systems.
Optimization and Allocation Systems
  • Order Optimization: Address intersystem data issues. A key goal is to replace a vendor's size/pack optimization product (SAS) and modernize existing services to use a real-time data source (via Kafka) instead of batch processes.
  • Replenishment: Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown  ARC system.
  • Allocations: Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown  KOALA system.

Skills You Have:

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java and JEE development, particularly Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Security.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.
  • Experience with build management tools (Gradle or Maven) and GIT.
Preferred Skills
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Experience with large-scale application troubleshooting and performance tuning.
  • Exposure to major cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience with microservices architecture.

Essential Functions:

The requirements listed below are representative of functions you may be required to perform; however, you may be required to perform additional functions. To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship.

  • Ability to perform the accountabilities listed in the “What You’ll Do” section.
  • Ability to comply with dress code requirements.
  • Basic math and reading skills, legible handwriting, and basic computer operation.
  • Ability to maintain prompt and regular attendance and meet scheduling requirements as set by our partner.
  • Ability to learn and comply with all company policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines.
  • Ability to give direction and to receive, understand, and proactively respond to direction from leadership and other company personnel.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and interact effectively and appropriately with others.
  • Ability to maintain composure and work in a fast-paced environment while accomplishing multiple tasks within established timeframes.
  • Ability to satisfactorily complete company training programs.
  • Ability to use a personal computer for tasks such as communicating and preparing reports.
  • Ability to plan, prioritize, and monitor activities across business units.
  • Ability to complete or oversee the completion of assigned projects in a timely manner.

Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a leading retail innovator transforming the shopping experience through cutting-edge technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

Role duration: 6 months with option to renew

Core hours: 9 am - 5 pm US Central Time Zone

*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.

We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team

  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads

Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English

The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach

What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together? A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.

Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality : At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving : We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (both written and spoken) is mandatory
  • Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese will be a significant advantage
  • Strong cross-cultural communication and leadership skills; comfortable operating in diverse international environments
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and deep understanding of cross-border trade regulations, logistics, and financing

What We Offer

  • Highly competitive consultancy package
  • Attractive performance-based bonuses tied to P&L results
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal leadership role in a fast-growing international trading house
  • Direct exposure to global markets and senior management in Asia
  • Dynamic, entrepreneurial environment with significant autonomy

Interested candidates should submit their detailed CV in English, including current and expected remuneration and availability.

Please click “Apply Now” or send your application to the provided contact.

title: Analista de Qualidade Pleno
description:
A Ausenco é uma empresa de rápido crescimento com grandes ideias. Redefinimos o que é possível em alguns dos projetos mais complexos e ambientes mais desafiadores do mundo. Nosso trabalho consiste em fornecer soluções inovadoras e de alto valor agregado em consultoria, execução de projetos, operação e manutenção de ativos. Com 21 escritórios em 9 países e projetos em mais de 80 localidades ao redor do mundo, criamos resultados sustentáveis para nossos colaboradores, clientes e comunidades.

Nossa equipe no Brasil está crescendo e estamos recrutando um(a) Analista de Qualidade Pleno para se juntar à nossa linha de negócios de Minerais e Metais no escritório de Belo Horizonte - MG.

Sobre a vaga:

  • Executar e monitorar as fases de iniciação, acompanhamento e encerramento de projetos, garantindo a conformidade com os requisitos de qualidade.
  • Realizar auditorias de entregáveis de engenharia, verificando a conformidade com padrões, normas e procedimentos.
  • Liderar auditorias internas e apoiar/participar em auditorias externas.
  • Aplicar pesquisas de expectativas e satisfação do cliente, consolidar os resultados e propor ações de melhoria.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho de qualidade dentro dos projetos.
  • Preparar, implementar e monitorar planos e documentação de qualidade de acordo com as normas e diretrizes internas.
  • Rastrear e atualizar registros de não conformidades, ações corretivas, ações preventivas, oportunidades de melhoria e riscos do projeto.
  • Planejar e conduzir treinamentos e iniciativas de conscientização para disseminar e garantir a correta aplicação dos procedimentos pelas equipes.
  • Preparar, revisar e gerenciar documentos do SGQ (procedimentos, instruções de trabalho, formulários e planos de qualidade).
  • Executar outras atividades relacionadas ao Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, conforme necessário.

Sobre você:

  • Ensino Superior em Engenharia, Gestão da Qualidade ou áreas afins.
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em funções relacionadas à qualidade, com familiaridade com rotinas de projetos em empresas de engenharia.
  • Conhecimento em Gestão da Qualidade.
  • Conhecimento da norma ISO 9001.
  • Conhecimento intermediário do Microsoft Office.
  • Perfil analítico.
  • Organizado.
  • Orientado para detalhes.
  • Comunicativo.
  • Ambivertido.
  • Concentrado.
  • Planejador.
  • Inglês em nível avançado.

Por que a Ausenco?

Apoiamos o crescimento individual e buscamos permitir que você trabalhe de uma forma que valorize seus pontos fortes e atenda às suas necessidades. Conheça nossa proposta de valor:

  • Remuneração e equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal – Além de um pacote de remuneração competitivo, experimente o melhor dos dois mundos com nosso modelo de trabalho híbrido, que permite equilibrar dias no escritório com trabalho em casa. Aproveite os benefícios de políticas de licença modernas, incluindo licença parental remunerada, e celebre conosco feriados especiais.
  • Avanço na carreira - Receba apoio no seu desenvolvimento contínuo através de treinamentos técnicos, programas de mentoria e frequentes oportunidades de networking.
  • Equilíbrio e Bem-Estar – Adote uma abordagem proativa para o seu bem-estar geral. Tenha acesso a aconselhamento confidencial, serviços de saúde e um programa de benefícios que atenda às suas necessidades.
  • Reconhecimento e Valorização - Participe de espaços multidirecionais onde se fomenta uma cultura de reconhecimento local e global, onde todos são reconhecidos por sua contribuição para os negócios e projetos.
  • Comunicação e Compromisso – Vivencie a experiência de trabalhar em uma empresa dinâmica com processos globais e colabore com líderes de renome no setor que valorizam sua contribuição.

Nossos colaboradores não se contentam com o status quo. Se você tem espírito empreendedor e quer ajudar a estabelecer um novo padrão em sustentabilidade, nós o ajudaremos a encontrar seu lugar. Isso significa trabalhar com você para desenvolver uma trajetória profissional e um conjunto de habilidades únicos, que estejam à altura de sua ambição.

Temos orgulho do trabalho que fazemos e o realizamos dentro de uma cultura aberta, honesta e colaborativa. Temos um histórico de atrair pessoas visionárias que abraçam desafios e entregam soluções criativas para cada projeto, e a sua opinião é uma parte importante dessa conversa.

Como empresa global, valorizamos e incentivamos a diversidade em seu sentido mais amplo – identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, experiência, nacionalidade, cor, idioma, religião, localização, deficiência, formação acadêmica, habilidades, estilos de trabalho e disponibilidade de tempo. Nossos ambientes de trabalho são baseados na confiança mútua e no respeito aos direitos e oportunidades de cada indivíduo.

Junte-se a nós e trabalhe de uma maneira melhor.

title: Especialista em Lean
description:
Vaga disponível inclusive para Pessoas com Deficiência ou Reabilitados pelo INSS.

O Lean Specialist em Melhoria Contínua fornecerá liderança prática para implantar, implementar e impulsionar o Programa de Lean Manufacturing nas instalações de R&M.

Essa posição liderará a conversão para uma organização enxuta, conduzindo a implementação de ferramentas como:

  • Value Stream Management, Safety, 5S, TPM, Standard Work, Kanban/Pull Systems, Root-Cause Problem Solving, Quality at the Source, Lean Daily Management, SMED, POKE-YOKE, Just-in-time, cellular manufacturing, A3/PDCA Problem Solving.

Trabalhará em estreita colaboração com diversas áreas da planta, incluindo: Qualidade de Serviço, Armazenagem, Manutenção & Reparo, Compras, HSE, Finanças, Operações, RH e Qualidade.

Funções e Responsabilidades:

  • Garantir que segurança e qualidade sejam prioridades em todas as áreas do negócio.
  • Cumprir com os mais altos padrões de governança corporativa, respeitando políticas, procedimentos, leis e regulamentações aplicáveis.
  • Conhecer e aplicar a Política de Qualidade da Weatherford, cumprindo os requisitos do Quality Systems Manual (QSM) e demais procedimentos.
  • Coordenar a implantação do Programa de Lean Manufacturing junto ao gerente de R&M e equipe de liderança da planta.
  • Desenvolver e implementar Value Stream Mapping (VSM), com planos de ação de melhoria contínua.
  • Criar e sustentar processos padronizados em toda a organização.
  • Implementar Shop Daily Management (SDM).
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em colaboração com gestores, supervisores, equipes e clientes, conduzindo projetos de produtividade, redução de desperdícios, eventos Kaizen e outras iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Facilitar a gestão diária Lean e promover a cultura Lean por meio de Gemba Walk, iniciativas de segurança, 5S e gestão visual.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria de processos e produtividade, tanto operacionais quanto transacionais, com foco em R&M.
  • Orientar e fornecer suporte à liderança das instalações quanto a princípios, metodologias e ferramentas Lean e/ou Six Sigma.
  • Manter comunicação eficaz com diferentes stakeholders para planejar atividades que atendam aos requisitos do negócio.
  • Garantir alinhamento e comunicação entre as linhas de produto e a área de R&M.
  • Apoiar e treinar a equipe de R&M em projetos de melhoria contínua e Kaizen que gerem resultados financeiros mensuráveis.
  • Ministrar treinamentos sobre Lean, conforme currículo interno.
  • Mentorar, influenciar e desenvolver futuros praticantes Lean.
  • Fornecer liderança necessária para promover mudanças e esforços de transformação Lean em todas as instalações de R&M designadas.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Bacharelado em Engenharia Industrial, Mecânica, de Produção ou Elétrica.
  • Mínimo de 3 a 5 anos de experiência em Lean Manufacturing como líder de melhoria contínua , lean lead, black belt ou função similar.
  • Experiência comprovada como facilitador de Kaizen.
  • Vivência prática com ferramentas: VSM, 5S, 5Porquês, TPM, Trabalho Padrão, Poka-Yoke, SIPOC, Mapeamento de Processos, Kanban, SMED, Hoshin, PDCA/DMAIC etc.
  • Certificação Lean Practitioner e/ou Six Sigma Black Belt (Desejável)
  • Domínio avançado das ferramentas Lean e capacidade de ensinar metodologias.
  • Perfil de liderança, inspirando e motivando equipes.
  • Comunicação eficaz em todos os níveis (chão de fábrica até diretoria).
  • Atitude prática, energia e presença no chão de fábrica.
  • Habilidade como “embaixador da mudança”.
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais e domínio de MS Office.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar prioridades em ambiente dinâmico.
  • Forte habilidade de treinamento e apresentação.
  • Inglês Avançado.
  • Espanhol será um diferencial.

description:
Sobre nós:

Somos um escritório de advocacia especializado em demandas envolvendo restrições de crédito e controvérsias financeiras, dedicados à defesa de consumidores que tiveram seu acesso ao mercado ou sua reputação afetados por registros indevidos. Atuamos em Canoas/RS com uma equipe altamente selecionada e comprometida com excelência e eficiência.

Estamos em expansão e buscamos profissionais formados em Direito ou estudantes do último ano da graduação para atuar como assistente jurídico .

A vaga é destinada a quem possui perfil organizado e proativo, e deseja desenvolver sua carreira em um ambiente dinâmico, moderno e fortemente orientado por tecnologia. Trabalhamos com sistemas internos próprios, alta demanda processual e forte integração com ferramentas de inteligência artificial , por isso buscamos alguém que já tenha facilidade com esse tipo de recurso. 

Incentivamos o crescimento profissional e oferecemos oportunidades reais de evolução dentro do time , de acordo com o desempenho e a dedicação de cada integrante.

Detalhes da Vaga:

Cargo: Assistente Jurídico

Local: Canoas/RS

Horário: Turno integral — das 9h às 18h (intervalo de 1h)

Formato: Presencial ( obrigatório )

Remuneração: R$ 4.000,00 mensais

Requisitos:

• Formação em Direito ou estar cursando o último ano da graduação

• Experiência prática de 1 a 3 anos na área jurídica

• Vivência com petições simples, réplicas, recursos e rotinas processuais

• Noções básicas de Direito do Consumidor

• Experiência prévia em escritório jurídico, gabinete do Fórum ou atendimento em órgãos como o PROCON

• Facilidade com ferramentas tecnológicas e abertura para uso de Inteligência Artificial no suporte às rotinas do escritório

title: Senior Generative AI Engineer
description:
Senior Generative AI Engineer – Copilot / Power Automate

We’re looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer who can elevate how teams work with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, process automation, user enablement, and platform governance —perfect for someone who loves building smart systems and helping people use them confidently.

You’ll design and optimize AI agents, troubleshoot complex Power Automate issues, coach non-technical users, and strengthen our Power Platform Center of Excellence. If you’re the kind of engineer who knows how to turn AI tooling into real organizational impact, this one’s for you.

What You’ll Own

AI Support & Troubleshooting

  • Serve as the go-to expert for Copilot Studio and Power Automate issues
  • Solve connector failures, permission problems, workflow errors, and broken automations
  • Provide fast, accurate root cause analysis

Agent Design & Optimization

  • Review and refine agents for performance, compliance, and scalability
  • Improve prompts, workflows, and architecture patterns
  • Ensure alignment with governance and platform best practices

User Enablement

  • Help employees safely build, extend, and optimize their agents
  • Explain platform capabilities and limits in accessible, non-technical language
  • Promote safe data usage and DLP-aligned behavior

Architecture & Governance

  • Apply knowledge of agent architectures, prompt lifecycles, and RAG patterns
  • Partner with security, data, and compliance teams to ensure DLP and governance alignment
  • Contribute to Power Platform Center of Excellence (COE) standards, monitoring, and lifecycle practices

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Build user guides, reference patterns, troubleshooting playbooks
  • Identify recurring issues and propose scalable solutions
  • Support observability, health monitoring, and platform oversight

What You Bring

Required

  • Hands-on expertise in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate (core)
  • Strong ability to diagnose, design, and optimize agent workflows
  • Understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem , DLP frameworks, and governance policies
  • Deep knowledge of agent architectures and prompt-response lifecycles
  • Excellent communication skills, especially with non-technical audiences

Preferred

  • Exposure to RAG , multi-agent orchestration, or MCP server concepts
  • Experience with observability or cost/governance monitoring
  • Familiarity with enterprise data environments (Snowflake, Dataverse, Azure Data Lake)
  • Prior involvement in a Power Platform COE

title: AS400 Analyst - L3 Support (Banking Domain)
description:
AS400 Analyst – L3 Support (Banking Domain) - 13193

Contract: CLT at UltraCon's Customer

Work Location: Itaim Bibi, São Paulo/SP (100% onsite)

Work Time: Business Hours

Language: English Advanced

Position: AS400 Analyst – L3 Support (Banking Domain)

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced AS/400 Analyst to provide L3 support for critical banking and clearing applications. The professional will work on incident resolution, maintenance activities, and user support for systems running on the AS/400 platform, including the GMI application (FIS), which is widely used for back-office clearing and accounting of exchange-traded and OTC derivatives. This role requires solid technical expertise and the ability to operate in a high-demand production support environment.

Mandatory Requirements:

• 4–8 years of experience working with AS/400 environments.

• Strong knowledge of RPG and DB2.

• Experience in production support, troubleshooting, and maintenance activities.

• Ability to analyze system behavior, identify issues, and coordinate solutions in complex environments.

• Advanced English for communication with global stakeholders.

Preferred Requirements (Nice to Have):

• Familiarity with GMI (FIS), particularly in clearing, settlement, and accounting processes.

• Previous experience in the Banking or Financial Services domain.

• Knowledge of derivatives operations, futures, options, and OTC processing.

• Exposure to vendor-managed applications and third-party support structures.

Main Responsibilities:

• Provide L3 support for the GMI application, including user assistance, incident resolution, and coordination with vendor teams when needed.

• Analyze and troubleshoot issues on the AS/400 platform, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.

• Execute support and maintenance activities to ensure application stability and availability.

• Monitor system processes, logs, and data flows to identify anomalies and recurring issues.

• Collaborate with business users to understand functional impacts and validate corrective actions.

• Participate in change management, ensuring controlled deployment and minimal production risk.

• Document operational procedures, updates, and resolutions to enhance knowledge sharing within the team.

• Contribute to ongoing improvements by identifying opportunities to optimize existing processes.

Soft Skills:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Clear and objective communication, especially when engaging with non-technical users.

• Ability to work in a structured, high-pressure environment.

• Collaboration and teamwork mindset.

• Attention to detail, ownership, and commitment to service quality.

Further information will be given along the technical interview.

Consultative Support

  • Offer insights on AI-driven features and innovative functionalities within CAS solutions.

Customer Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and continuous learning for CAS users.
  • Gather feedback and communicate actionable insights to ACS International for product improvement.
  • Support initiatives that promote customer success and solution optimization.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations at workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed under the engagement.

Required Expertise:

  • Proven experience in designing and delivering technical training programs.
  • Strong ability to simplify and communicate complex scientific concepts.
  • Familiarity with CAS solutions (SciFinder, STNext) and other scientific information platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Skilled in virtual training tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx) and CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX).

Qualifications:

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.

Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.

This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.

title: DevOps Pleno
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um DevOps Pleno para fortalecer nosso time de infraestrutura e ajudar a garantir a escalabilidade, automação e confiabilidade dos nossos serviços. Você atuará em um ambiente altamente dinâmico, com Kubernetes em produção, GitOps, pipelines CI/CD, observabilidade e práticas modernas de engenharia. Você trabalhará lado a lado com backend, frontend, produto e SRE, garantindo que nossa plataforma continue crescendo com segurança, estabilidade e performance.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps e administrar fluxos de deploy utilizando FluxCD;
  • Gerenciar e evoluir nossos clusters Kubernetes via Rancher;
  • Implementar e aprimorar pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Automatizar provisionamento, scaling e operações com ferramentas como Karpenter;
  • Acompanhar métricas, logs e dashboards em Grafana, Prometheus e demais ferramentas de observabilidade;
  • Atuar no gerenciamento de serviços e recursos em AWS (EKS, EC2, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, etc.);
  • Trabalhar com DNS, segurança e performance usando Cloudflare;
  • Colaborar com o time de desenvolvimento para melhorar a confiabilidade e performance das aplicações;
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança, automação e qualidade operacional.

É fundamental que você conheça:

  • Kubernetes em produção;
  • Rancher para gestão de clusters;

title: Chef Tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
  • Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
  • Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
  • Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
  • Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
  • Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
  • Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
  • Responsible for follow-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
  • Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.

  • Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
  • Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
  • Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food & Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
  • Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION

  • A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
  • A culinary school degree is required.
  • Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
  • Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
  • Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
  • Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
  • Intermediate computer software skills required.
  • Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
Our future is yours!

Who are we?

We are Bridge Polymers, an international company with multiple branches across Europe and

beyond. We trade in polyolefins - something you’ve probably never heard of, yet encounter

every day. These are types of plastic with hundreds of different applications. Our customers use

these plastic pellets to create their products. Our suppliers are global producers of

petrochemicals, and we focus primarily on trading polyethylene and polypropylene.

Bridge Polymers has offices in several countries, including Spain, Poland, Romania, Brazil and

more, with our headquarters based in Eindhoven, the Netherlands. The market we operate in is

fast-paced. Thanks to our straightforward, honest, and down-to-earth company culture, we can

perform at our best even in the hectic world of fast trading. We are flexible and work with short

lines of communication, allowing us to always stay on top of the business!

Your responsibilities

Working at Bridge Polymers means working on your own future within a dynamic company. This

is especially true for the Inside Sales Specialist we are currently seeking. How your journey

unfolds and where you ultimately end up is largely in your own hands.

As an Inside Sales Specialist, you will receive a structured onboarding and development

program designed to help you quickly gain confidence in your role. From day one, you will be

actively contributing while deepening your knowledge in the following areas:

Business Development & Prospection

● Research new markets and identify potential commercial opportunities.

● Analyse import statistics and market data to uncover new prospects.

● Proactively engage with potential customers through calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

● Set up daily meetings with prospects to explore potential collaborations.

● Contact customers to understand their product requirements and gather relevant market

intelligence.

Sales Support

● Prepare, create, and send offers and proformas.

● Manage follow-ups to support the full sales cycle from lead to deal.

● Assist in applying for credit limits and monitoring customer credit status.

● Follow up on payments, required documentation, and overall deal progress.

Customer Administration

● Handle day-to-day communication with prospects and clients.

● Ensure all customer data, requests, and feedback are accurately documented and

managed.

● Support the sales team by maintaining a smooth and organized administrative workflow.

In short: an excellent career outlook - and it’s up to you to fulfil your potential.

Requirements

● You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, International trade or similar field.

● You have at least 1–2 years of experience in a sales or business development role.

● Knowledge of import/export processes and B2B sales is a strong advantage.

● You are independent, ambitious, commercially minded, proactive, and able to perform

under pressure.

● You are fluent in spoken and written English and Portuguese.

● You are currently residing in Brazil, ideally near Blumenau and willing to commute to our

office.

What we offer

● Excellent employment conditions.

● Salary progression linked to your personal growth and performance.

● Mentorship from experienced professionals to support your development.

● The opportunity to be part of a dynamic, international team.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
About the Company

Our client is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of two- and three-wheelers, with a strong global presence across more than 80 countries. In Brazil, the company’s strategic expansion in Latin America and is a rapidly growing multinational motorcycle manufacturer and distributor with annual revenues exceeding BRL 300 million. With operations spanning four key locations- they serve customers across all 27 federative units. As they continue to scale our team, dealer network, and market presence, we are building a high-performance, agile, and people-first organization, and are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner to support this growth journey.

Role Overview

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) acts as a strategic advisor to business leaders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Dealer Development, and Support Functions in Brazil. This role is responsible for aligning HR strategy with business objectives, driving people processes, and enabling a strong performance & culture framework in a rapidly growing market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic HR Partnering

  • Serve as the primary HR point-of-contact for business leaders across Brazil.
  • Understand business priorities and design HR interventions to support organizational goals.
  • Drive workforce planning, capability assessments, and talent deployment strategies.

2. Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

  • Partner with global and regional TA teams to define hiring needs and support local recruitment.
  • Oversee onboarding and cultural integration for new hires in Brazil.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian labour regulations during hiring and setup.

3. Performance Management

  • Drive annual and mid-year performance review processes.
  • Coach managers on goal setting, feedback, performance conversations, and development plans.
  • Support the implementation of global performance frameworks adapted to local needs.

4. Employee Relations & Compliance

  • Serve as the first point of escalation for employee issues, grievances, or policy clarification.
  • Ensure adherence to Brazil’s labour laws and internal policies.
  • Partner with legal advisors where required for sensitive ER cases.

5. Talent Development & Culture Building

  • Identify capability gaps and support local training, leadership development, and skill-building initiatives.
  • Lead cultural engagement programs in alignment with Client’s global values.
  • Support DE&I initiatives and cross-cultural employee programs.

6. HR Operations & Policy Management

  • Manage end-to-end HR lifecycle processes (payroll coordination, leaves, benefits, contract changes).
  • Collaborate with HQ in India for alignment on global HR processes.
  • Maintain HR data accuracy, dashboards, and workforce analytics for decision-making.

7. Organizational Development

  • Support org structure changes, role evaluations, job descriptions, and SOP creation for growing functions.
  • Lead change management initiatives during scale-up phases or new business launches.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s/ Masters Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field.
  • 5–10 years of HR Generalist/HRBP experience, preferably in multinational or high-growth organizations.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian labour laws and HR compliance.
  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and managing end-to-end HR processes.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural environment with teams across India and LATAM.
  • Fluency in Portuguese (mandatory) and English (strong proficiency required).

Key Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management
  • Problem-solving & decision-making
  • Cultural adaptability
  • Communication & influencing skills
  • Confidentiality and integrity
  • High ownership and agility
  • Ability to operate independently in a startup-like environment

Use design software (Adobe Suite, Procreate) and explore AI-assisted illustration tools (e.g., for rapid prototyping).

title: Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, partnering with the world’s most ambitious retailers and brands to put the customer at the heart of every decision. The Price and Promotion consulting and implementation manager will lead the deployment of dunnhumby’s P&P solutions to new and existing clients. Responsibilities

Analyse large and complex datasets to identify potential gaps and inconsistencies during the deployment process.

  • GO Live support: Contribute to the successful execution of the GO Live phase by demonstrating the tool’s added value to the client. This involves organizing and participating in client sessions, conducting category analysis, proposing optimal solutions, and monitoring progress through measurement, reporting, and activity tracking.

Required Experience

  • Extensive experience working at a retailer/ FMCG within the Merchandising space and in enterprise software implementations. Specific expertise in Price and Promotions solutions desirable
  • A college degree or equivalent professional experience required
  • Strong business analysis and data analytics skills. Data visualization, advanced Microsoft Excel, programming language a plus
  • Support pre-sales activities and lead generation in coordination with Sales and Client teams to ensure the proper positioning of our P&P solutions to meet clients’ needs.
  • Experience in project management and workflow optimization

What you can expect from us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance.   • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Business Administration, or related fields.

  • Solid understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements (NRs), engineering standards, and EHS.

  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, with strong presence in operations and a hands-on approach.
  • High level of discipline, organization, and operational rigor.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
  • Agile, creative, and solution-oriented profile.
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to anticipate risks.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams with engagement and accountability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Resilience and ability to deliver impactful results under pressure.

title: CONSULTOR COMERCIAL DE MÍDIA
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Atuar na comercialização para o mercado local, apresentando propostas que integrem o ecossistema Iguatemi. Responsável por abrir leads, prospectar negócios e gerar receita com players locais. Conduzir negociações, operacionalizar acordos e atender lojistas, incluindo negócios fechados pelo Key Account. Comercializar espaços para eventos e garantir a execução das oportunidades geradas.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Fidelizar os clientes atuais e prospectar novos, apresentando a Iguatemi, seus shoppings e oportunidades comerciais, a fim de trazer receita e 100% de ocupação para o shopping sob sua gestão;
  • Comercializar propriedades como locações temporárias, mídia, merchandising, eventos, patrocínios e demais que englobam o Planejamento Comercial Anual (PAC) do shopping sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Ter controle rigoroso sobre o fluxo de faturamento dos contratos do shopping, garantindo a menor inadimplência possível;
  • Manter o fluxo direto da informação/comunicação das suas atividades junto à gerência comercial regional, para garantir alinhamento de informações no mercado, evitando a sobreposição de negociações;
  • Visitar a concorrência local/regional, pesquisar oportunidades de negócio nos ambientes digitias (Instagram, LinkedIn, sites de varejo, etc) relevantes a sua unidade a fim de identificar clientes potenciais e se manter atualizado quanto às novidades do mercado;
  • Responsável por atualizar e acompanhar diariamente o placar dos seus índices de performance, resultados, pipeline de vendas, vacância, detectando necessidades de planos de ação para atingimento de metas e maximização do potencial de vendas de propriedades;
  • Realizar reuniões quinzenais junto à gerência geral, Marketing e Operações do seu shopping visando otimizar oportunidades de projetos que possam ser comercializados e alinhar negócios em andamento;
  • Participar de pelo menos uma reunião semanalmente com os demais gestores da unidade de atuação (Matinal) e participar semanalmente da Reunião Comercial Operacional (RECOP);
  • Preparar materiais e apresentações para a diretoria e outras áreas conforme demanda;
  • Gerenciar todo processo de negociação em conjunto com jurídico, shopping e lojista para garantir a efetivação dos contratos nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Garantir o monitoramento de todas as etapas pós negociação, documentação, SISCOM (se houver), assinatura e entrega da propriedade;
  • Dar suporte aos seus clientes em todo o contato com o shopping, desde aprovação de projetos, layouts, autorizações de entrada, assinatura de contrato, quitação de boleto, etc;
  • No caso de shoppings com assistente, fazer a gestão do assistente e sua rotina, com foco em retenção e desenvolvimento de carreira dentro da empresa;
  • Realizar todas as atividades em conformidade com as normas da empresa e ao Programa de Excelência Iguatemi (PEXI).

Necessário disponibilidade para trabalhar modelo presencial em Santa Catarina - Tijucas.

title: Especialista Customer Success Advisory (CSA)
description:
Descrição da vaga

A RPE tem como objetivo viabilizar o amplo crescimento dos negócios varejistas e da economia nacional por meio de soluções ágeis, robustas, seguras e integradas a todo ecossistema de serviços financeiros.

Com mais de oitenta profissionais especialistas em tecnologia e meios de pagamento, atendemos mais de quarenta negócios varejistas, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas para a democratização do crédito nos pontos de vendas.

Se você está pronto para crescer e voar com a gente, esta é sua chance!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de CSA para fazer parte do nosso time de Customer Success, que tem como objetivo garantir o sucesso dos emissores, fortalecendo o relacionamento, impulsionando a adoção das soluções RPE e sustentando o crescimento de receita e satisfação dos clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Análise e Inteligência Consultiva

  • Analisar dados dos emissores e conectar informações de negócio para gerar insights acionáveis que fortaleçam a operação de concessão e recuperação de crédito;
  • Monitorar indicadores-chave de performance de concessão e recuperação (ex: Creliq, Perda) para identificar padrões, oportunidades e riscos; e
  • Desenvolver narrativas executivas que facilitem o entendimento e a tomada de decisão dos CSMs e dos emissores e que se conectem às soluções fornecidas pela RPE.

Playbooks de Sucesso

  • Estruturar, documentar e atualizar Playbooks de Sucesso fundamentados em dados, boas práticas do segmento e lições aprendidas;
  • Orientar e capacitar os CSMs para aplicação prática dos playbooks com cada emissor;
  • Monitorar continuamente os resultados das iniciativas de fomento e retenção, registrando evidências e aprendizados; e
  • Retroalimentar e aprimorar os playbooks com base em performance real, garantindo evolução contínua.

Apoio ao Time de CS

  • Apoiar o time de CSMs na leitura de indicadores e na elaboração de recomendações estratégicas aos emissores;
  • Atuar como referência técnica nos temas e soluções de concessão e recuperação.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência prévia em áreas analíticas: crédito, cobrança, recuperação e risco.
  • Conhecimento sólido de indicadores e métricas de concessão e recuperação de crédito.
  • Forte capacidade de análise, interpretação de dados e geração de insights práticos.
  • Experiência com construção de relatórios, análises, dashboards ou estudos técnicos.
  • Habilidade para estruturar narrativas claras, didáticas e orientadas a valor.
  • Capacidade de transformar análises em recomendações objetivas aplicáveis pelos CSMs.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (Power BI, Looker, Data Studio ou similares).
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de simplificar temas complexos.

Informações adicionais

  • Regime de Contratação: PJ
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido, 2x por semana no escritório no bairro Vila Olímpia/SP e 1 dia de visita aos clientes.

title: Sales Operation Manager (Retail Channel)
description:
About us

OPPO was founded in 2004 and is one of the global leaders in smart device innovation.

OPPO's footprint extends to more than 70 countries and regions, with over 300,000 sales outlets and 3,300 official service centers, where it employs more than 40,000 people dedicated to creating a better life for customers around the world through smarter products and services.

We are looking for experienced talents to join us on this exciting journey!

Requirements:

  • Advanced English is mandatory.
  • Knowledge strategic supply plans.
  • Strong relationship management with retailers .

  • Sense of owner and responsibilities with deadlines.

Note: Please submit your CV in English version.

title: Team Manager Customer Success
description:
#Conheça um pouco sobre a área:

Customer Success é a arte de conduzir o cliente rumo a resultados reais de negócio — e de evoluir continuamente essa jornada.

No nosso time, isso significa escalar uma operação inteligente, automatizada e orientada a dados, que gere engajamento, retenção e crescimento sustentável da base de clientes de médio porte.

Buscamos uma liderança estratégica e prática, com sólida experiência em operações B2B e relacionamento com personas de Marketing e Vendas, capaz de conectar tecnologia, dados e processos para impulsionar o sucesso em larga escala.

Essa pessoa será responsável por desenvolver o time, otimizar a jornada e liderar uma operação mid-touch, garantindo impacto e eficiência em cada etapa da experiência do cliente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

#Desafios que você vai encontrar:

  • Liderar o time de Customer Success responsável por contas de médio porte e alta volumetria, garantindo uma jornada escalável, eficiente e orientada a valor;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com sponsors e lideranças dos clientes da sua carteira, conduzindo uma régua executiva de relacionamento (QBRs, check-ins, business reviews, etc.);
  • Mapear, implementar e evoluir ferramentas e integrações que suportem a automação da jornada do cliente (e-mails automáticos, fluxos in-app, alertas, health scores, etc.);
  • Analisar indicadores-chave (NRR, churn, adoção, engajamento, uso de funcionalidades) e ajustar estratégias com foco em eficiência e impacto em escala;
  • Criar estratégias de segmentação e personalização em massa, com base em dados comportamentais e de perfil;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as áreas de Marketing, Vendas, Produto e Suporte para garantir consistência e fluidez na experiência do cliente ao longo de toda a jornada;
  • Liderar rituais de acompanhamento de performance do time, com foco em produtividade, eficiência operacional e resultados de retenção;
  • Contribuir com visão estratégica para o crescimento sustentável da base, desenhando mecanismos de escala e engajamento contínuo.

Requisitos e qualificações

✔️ # Conhecimentos importantes para a posição:

  • Ensino superior completo (pós-graduação ou MBA são diferenciais);
  • Experiência prévia liderando times de Customer Success ou áreas correlatas em operações de alta escala, com foco em clientes B2B de médio porte (Commercial/SMB);
  • Vivência em relacionamento executivo com líderes de Marketing e/ou Vendas, com histórico de condução de QBRs e conversas estratégicas com C-levels;
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de automação e CRM (ex: Salesforce, HubSpot), plataformas de CS (ex: Gainsight, Totango) e sistemas de disparo de comunicações automatizadas;
  • Capacidade analítica para monitorar indicadores de saúde da base, churn, adoção, engajamento e expansão — com domínio de ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau, Excel avançado ou SQL básico;
  • Habilidade em desenhar e evoluir playbooks de atendimento e jornadas baseadas em segmentação e comportamento do cliente;
  • Comunicação clara, empática e orientada a resultados, com experiência em liderar times consultivos, mesmo em operações automatizadas e de alta escala.

#PraVocê Nossos Beneficios:

PraVocê no dia a dia :

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Gympass/TotalPass;
  • Vittude;
  • Auxílio home-office;

PraVocê & Família :

  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico (odonto é opcional);
  • Auxílio creche (até os 6 anos completos da criança):
  • Licença-Maternidade, Paternidade e Adotante Estendidas (#todasasfamíliasimportam);

title: Electrical VDC Team Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.

Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil. Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.

Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be apart of --> eracore.com

Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.

Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

title: Líder Técnico III - Visão Computacional
description:

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo na área de tecnologia, preferencialmente em Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;

Experiência em:

  • Linguagem de programação Python ou Go,
  • Métodos estatísticos para análise de dados,
  • Desenvolvimento de algoritmos de Machine Learning/Deep Learning,
  • Arquitetura em microserviços,
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações web modernas,
  • Banco de dados de alto volume (relacional, não relacional, data lake ou data warehouse);

Conhecimentos em:

  • Conhecimento em Keras, PyTorch e TensorFlow,
  • MLOps,
  • Plataformas Cloud (AWS ou Azure),
  • CI/CD,
  • Melhores práticas de desenvolvimento,
  • Metodologias ágeis.

Seria interessante se você tivesse:

  • Conhecimento em soluções SDN;
  • Prática em projetos com equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimentos em: Big Data, Data Science, gRPC, banco de dados temporal e mock de dados;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura e escrita e intermediário para conversação.

Informações adicionais

Horário das atividades: Segunda a sexta, das 8h as 12h e das 13h30 as 17h30.

Local das atividades: As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de teletrabalho "home office".
